notes.title: FULL RELEASE!
notes.notes:
ːhydː The game has been finally moved from Early Acess to Full Release state! ːhydː

The main balance issues and bugs was fixed (thank you, community!). We leave Early Access state, but we are not going to stop working on the game. 

So you can expect some game updates in the future ːsteamhappyː

Thanks again everyone!

notes.title: Pantheon of Fat Chickens Update
notes.notes:
Panteon of Fat Chickens has been buffed ːbuild_toolː

Pantheon of Fat Chickens
At the beginning of the battle 2 random units in the army get +20 to life.
+2 to food from chicken farms.

Chicken Devil
Fallen chickens revive with 50% chance.
Chicken devils can be summoned (using zombie chickens).

All other beliefs remain the same.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26047560/9bebe5eddb777c46edecdb010e324f7da374d05a.png

Also F12 key should save screenshots now.

notes.title: Equality Church Update
notes.notes:
Equality Church has been adjusted one more time. 

Equality Church
The last two killed units will be revived after each battle.

Autonomy
5 peasants can be hired without town halls. Chicken farm appears for free.

Freedom of Worship
Paladin can heal units of any type. Church appears for free.

People Preach
All attacking militiamen change their side and join our forces. The price of hiring a peasant decreases by 50 gold.

The community
One additional unit of any kind can be hired. (You still need buildings to hire units).

notes.title: Update 2 (Pantheon of Fat Chickens)
notes.notes:
In this update Pantheon of Fat Chickens religion tree has been improved.

- Nutritious Diet changed
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26047560/231a6042e5ec66b1ca98facd30faa74e7f0f8b92.png

- Chicken Devil changed
Chicken devils is now summoned using zombie chickens.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26047560/15e6ebfbecbf1b38e43ff8de9c2b7c52d17ccb6b.png

Some bugfixes:
- Fixed "Attackers list" glitch when unit stands below attackers list button
- Some mistakes in the game texts fixed
- Romans religion buttons positions fixed


Nutritious Diet can become an alternative to the paladins. You get health bonus for five strong units, but paladins become useless.

As for the Chicken Devils, I think you don't want to spend faith points summoning them :) But spending zombie chickens is ok.

notes.title: Update (Bugfixes and new dungeons)
notes.notes:
This update is mostly concerned with bug fixes.

Bugs:
- Unicorn achievement didn't work
- Game freezes when playing Invasion of Zombie Chickens
- Game freezes when picking People Preach too early
- Unit info (on the battelfield) draw when unit is invisible
- Some mistakes in the texts corrected

Added 3 new dungeons. All the dungeons have a pair now.
1) Magical field (Reward: Unicorns get healing ability)
2) The Mirror (Reward: Scroll of Shrinking)
3) Devil's seal (Reward: Chicken Devil)
